normative_rule: This is the sole canonical join across change.json claim_delta IDs, statistics_and_claim_contract.md ladder IDs, and claim_test_applicability.json deferred-text IDs. Labels are aliases only through an explicit row below; no suffix, ordinal, or prose match is permitted. C1--C5 are conceptual future claims, not current evidence claims.

validation.proposal_claim_ids: Set equality is required between change.json#/claim_delta/claims/*/claim_id and claims/*/proposal_claim_id; each value must occur exactly once in each source.
validation.statistics_claim_ids: Set equality is required between the six C0--C5 ladder IDs and claims/*/statistics_claim_id; each value must occur exactly once in each source.
validation.canonical_claim_ids: Every canonical_claim_id must be unique and every alias lookup must resolve to exactly one row.
validation.applicability_claim_ids: After nulls are removed, set equality is required between claims/*/applicability_claim_id and claim_test_applicability.json#/deferred_text_claims; each C1--C3 value must occur exactly once.
validation.terminal_status: Every C1--C5 row must remain deferred and nonclaiming under this protocol; any population rejection or current scientific-claim status is a hard failure.
validation.unknown_or_duplicate: Any orphan, duplicate, unknown, implicit, many-to-one, or one-to-many join is a hard failure of PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL.

PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL.expected: Assigned A4 rows, representation-neutral world/action scoring, failure inclusion, and sterility/leakage pass for the descriptive B3 package; A4 efficacy and mechanism values neither gate a current claim nor create one.
PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL.falsifies: A missing/dropped A4 row, representation-dependent score, omitted failure, leakage, sterility failure, or any conversion of A4 efficacy into current-claim credit; weak A4 efficacy alone does not fail integrity.

PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUS.expected: No Stage-D evidence artifact is required for the deferred C1--C3 dispositions. A future separately ratified DEFERRED_ASSOCIATIVE_LORA_PREREGISTRATION may make T10 a mandatory transport/component control before a C5 claim, but T10 is not that successor's headline.
PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUS.falsifies: Blocking the B3/deferred C1--C3 disposition for absent Stage D, or making a future LoRA claim without the tests mandated by its separately ratified successor proposal.

PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLA.procedure: Parse all three normative sources at their declared locations, prove the exact set equalities and uniqueness rules above, reproduce T09 and T10 applicability by canonical_claim_id, and reproduce DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION for C1--C4 and DEFERRED_ASSOCIATIVE_LORA_PREREGISTRATION for C5 rather than inferring a claim from a favorable B3 value.
PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLA.expected: Exactly six one-to-one proposal/statistics rows exist; exactly canonical C1--C3 join to the three deferred-text applicability IDs; T09/T10 and the terminal deferred statuses reproduce exactly.
PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLA.falsifies: Any orphan, duplicate, unknown, implicit, ambiguous, missing, or extra alias/applicability row, or any current/population claim status.

claim_firewall.retired_fixed_source_language: Fixed-source representation/use results cannot establish an action-conditioned continual-learning claim.
claim_firewall.current_protocol_claim_status: No C1--C5 scientific claim is available; B3 is DEV/falsification/descriptive only, Stage C is DEFERRED_NEW_PREREGISTRATION, and the associative-LoRA successor is separately deferred.
